name: outrunner 14p - PLACEHOLDER
note: The firmware's compiled-in placeholders (board_cal.c), as a file: the order of magnitude of a small 14-pole outrunner, measured against nothing. tools/commission.py writes a real motor's numbers over the record; a profile like this one is how they are kept and put back. `drive` keys are coaxial.drive.PARAMS names in SI; `model` keys are coaxial.drive.MODEL_PARAMS names in SI.
